corrected.derivation: derived: slide 18 ('Saffire-I-III Results', Urban et al., ASGSR 2017, NTRS 20180005168) says 'low-gravity' about the large thin charring surface. Slides 14/23/30 identify that sample as the 40.6 x 94 cm cotton-fiberglass of Saffire-III (III-1) and Saffire-I. The same deck labels these burns 'µ-g' (slide 31) and 'microgravity' (slide 17). The deck reports Saffire-I and III together, so it is not independent per flight (SHARED_LINEAGE). The deck does not itself tie 'low-gravity' to Cygnus in one sentence.
